messages:
Samira Kaur: Hi team, starting Monday as AE (hello!). Quick checklist: CRM seat, Dialpad + voicemail, Gong access, AE playbook edit rights, and the prospects list for my region. Who's the owner for each?
Leo Gomez: Welcome Samira!! I'll own CRM + prospects list. What's your company email?
Samira Kaur: samira.kaur@redwood.ai — thanks Leo. Edit rights on playbook would be great so I can add call notes.
Talia Reed: I'll handle Gong and Dialpad. For Dialpad voicemail you can record in-app or upload an mp3. Use this short script: "Hi, this is Samira from Redwood Inference. Quick question about X—can I grab 15 minutes?"
Samira Kaur: Perfect. Can someone also point me to the one-pagers and objection battlecards? Want to review before demos.
Leo Gomez: Collateral lives in Sales > Shared > AE-Collateral. I'll add you to the folder and create a saved view in CRM for "North East SMB".
Provisioning Bot: Created ticket PRV-2302 for: CRM seat, Dialpad seat, Gong access. ETA 12 hours.
Talia Reed: Gong invite sent to samira.kaur@redwood.ai. Share a recording from the "Top Demo Clips" playlist tonight — good examples for your first week.
Samira Kaur: Got the Gong invite. One nit: I'm not seeing the playbook in Drive link Leo posted.
Leo Gomez: Oops, fixed permissions. Try now. Also added you to #ae-buddies Slack channel. Ping me for shadowing slots.
Samira Kaur: Access works now, thank you. Added a comment in the playbook about scheduling discovery next week.
Talia Reed: Quick note on Dialpad: enable "Do Not Disturb" for focus blocks and set busy greeting for demos.
Samira Kaur: Good tip. Last question: who queues up the demo accounts / staging links? Need a demo org for walkthroughs.
Leo Gomez: Repo for demo creds is in 1Password under "Sales/Demos". I assigned the demo org to you.
Samira Kaur: Awesome — that's everything for now. I'll mark follow-ups in this thread if anything else pops up. Appreciate the speedy help! :raised_hands: 
Provisioning Bot: Update PRV-2302: CRM + Gong + Dialpad provisioned. Ticket closed.
